In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover two major stories shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
1. Medicine Price Caps & Drug Shortages
India recently allowed prices of two key cancer drugs—cisplatin and carboplatin—to rise by up to 50% after shortages emerged in major hospitals. The story explores how India's medicine price-control system balances affordability with availability, and why keeping prices too low can sometimes make essential drugs unviable to produce, leading to supply shortages.
